title: Hotels and Harvey Girls
text: Mojave's hospitality trade began with the opening of the Morrissey Hotel in 1876. The Fred Harvey organization also operated a Harvey House there, with Harvey Girls serving meals.

s1.title: Mojave, CA (Digital-Desert)
s1.quote: Mojave provided hospitality to travelers, begining with the opening of the Morrissey Hotel in 1876. ... the Fred Harvey organization operated a 'Harvey House', complete with 'Harvey Girls' serving meals to weary travelers and miners.
